result.title: Single-Database Rewards Are Hackable: Counterfactual Execution for Trustworthy Text-to-SQL RL
result.comment: 4 pages + references and appendix (12 pages total). Code: https://github.com/RishiiGamer2201/counterfactual-sql-rewards
result.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for text-to-SQL agents pays a query when its result matches the reference on one database. However, a wrong query can match by luck when the data lack the rows that expose its bug. We study a counterfactual-database (CF) reward that also runs the final query on a few hidden, code-generated copies of the database and pays only if all results match (strict form) or by the share matched (mean form). On 1,302 synthetic audit questions, the strict form lowers the share of buggy queries paid in full from 29.5% to 16.8% and of reward hacks from 54.1% to 1.9%, rejecting 0 of 2,847 correct queries; copies from a family-blind generator do about as well. In a controlled GRPO comparison on a 3.35B model with three seeds per arm, training on the mean form did not improve in-domain accuracy (8.4% vs 11.7%), because the two rewards disagreed on only 5-7% of rollouts; on Spider it gained 1.6 points. One seed reverses both signs, so single-seed reward comparisons mislead. Code: https://github.com/RishiiGamer2201/counterfactual-sql-rewards ; data, models, demo: https://huggingface.co/counterfactual-sql

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出 text-to-SQL 的 RL 奖励只在一个数据库上比对结果，错误查询可能因数据缺行而侥幸匹配；为此提出反事实数据库奖励，在若干隐藏的代码生成数据库副本上执行最终查询，按全匹配或匹配比例给付奖励，并用合成审计题与 GRPO 对照实验评估其抑制奖励 hack 的效果与代价。
AI.relevance_reason: 用反事实数据副本检验答案是否依赖正确证据、并据此构造奖励，这一思路或可为 LVR 中核查 latent 状态是否真正使用视觉证据及轨迹级监督设计提供可核查线索；但场景为纯文本 SQL，与视觉推理的迁移性尚需判断。
